scenarios.business_objective: Validate user mutation persistence during RabbitMQ broker outage, durable outbox backlog, and successful post-recovery drain with zero event loss
scenarios.expected_result: Broker outage rejected cleanly with PublisherConnectionError, mutation preserved in PostgreSQL outbox, reconnection and dispatcher.dispatch_once() drains pending event with published_at settled, idle retry confirms downstream idempotency, zero event loss and zero duplicate business effect
scenarios.actual_result: PostgreSQL outbox backlog preserved during broker outage; publisher restored to RabbitMQ (port 5672); dispatch_once() succeeded with DispatchOutcome.PUBLISHED; published_at settled in DB; subsequent dispatch returned IDLE; zero event loss and zero duplicate effect verified

scenarios.business_objective: Validate workflow engine outage fails cleanly with WorkflowEngineConnectionError without corrupting application state and proves successful post-recovery query retry
scenarios.expected_result: WorkflowEngineConnectionError raised on outage, persistent state intact with zero corrupt mappings, reconnecting to Flowable (port 8080) restores query functionality cleanly with zero duplicate tasks
scenarios.actual_result: WorkflowEngineConnectionError raised deterministically on outage; zero corrupt task mappings; post-recovery query to live Flowable succeeded with valid task list; zero duplicate process or task effect
